ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_weighted_abs_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Use logsigmoid on margin weighted by absolute advantage_gap to ensure numerical stability and monotonic penalty without sign conflicts, retaining smooth importance weighting by magnitude.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
 lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
 adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
 weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
 margin = lpw - lpl
 loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(margin) * abs(adv_gap) * weight
 loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
 return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    adv_gap = batch["advantage_gap"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss = ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin)), ops.abs(adv_gap))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
